name: Dr. Simon Vale
identity: A British academic man in his late thirties, slim build, short tousled dark blond hair, a neatly trimmed short beard, intelligent hazel eyes behind thin round tortoiseshell glasses.
personality: Authoritative but intriguing academic historian. Precise, measured language; builds suspense with rhetorical questions; separates documented fact from theory ('officially...', 'what we know is...', 'the theory goes...'); dry wit.
voice_style: a mid-toned, articulate male voice with an educated southern English British accent and an engaging, varied cadence that slows down for emphasis, authoritative and confident

16x9.camera: Medium shot, 16:9, static camera on a tripod, framed from the waist up
16x9.lighting: Professional studio lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture.
16x9.default_action: with measured, expressive hand gestures and occasional nods for emphasis.

default.outfit: a navy knitted crew-neck jumper over a light grey collared shirt
default.scene: a moody podcast studio with dark acoustic foam panels, warm low lighting, a broadcast microphone on a boom arm positioned to the side so it does not cover his face, and shelves of old books behind him
default.ambience: Quiet studio room tone, no music.
